NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed twice (+3 lines) and says the failing tests are fixed. The label came with no written feedback, and the commit list is unchanged.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌ | "Fix click behavior on text and icons" fixes a bug introduced by the first commit, so it should be squashed into it per commit discipline. |
| ⚠️ | CI status isn't available, so "fixed the failing tests" can't be confirmed. |
| ❌ | Self-review items for end-to-end testing of the buttons and corner cases are unchecked, and the click bug shows this testing was needed. |
| ℹ️ | The design thread (Karl Stolley) suggests flexbox/grid with the icon and text as separate elements. It's unclear whether this PR follows that. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to squash the fix commit and finish testing; no reviewer assignment yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please squash the "Fix click behavior" commit into the commit it fixes (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)). Also finish the unchecked testing items in the self-review checklist, and confirm CI is green after the push.
```
